solution.what: M912 roll 34 frame 0947 index card gives the subject line of 10020-60; M1024 roll 310 frame 0051 is a withdrawal card: file 10020 transferred to MID (RG 165 entry 65), not digitised.
Web search on Riverbank/Friedman 1917 + Tampico and on WCD 10020 / MID undeciphered messages: only general history (Riverbank traffic mostly Mexican government). No edition or decipherment.
